name: Having Other Gods
overview: Scripture firmly commands exclusive devotion to the LORD, forbidding the worship or acknowledgment of other gods as seen in Exodus 20:3 and Exodus 34:14, where God is described as a jealous God who demands undivided loyalty. The uniqueness and holiness of the LORD are exalted in Exodus 15:11, highlighting that no other gods compare to Him. Joshua 23 warns the people against associating with the gods of surrounding nations or serving them, emphasizing that turning to other gods leads to God's righteous anger and swift judgment, including the loss of the blessings He has given.
